posts.cooked:
Kismet - Charmed Scoundrel

Kismet [70]

In Play: The Talisman [7]

Trash:

Additional Effects:

  • SV: Kismet deals each hero 1 psychic damage.
  • Whenever a hero target deals another hero target 4 or more damage, destroy 1 jinx card.
  • EV: Reveal top of villain deck. If it is a Lucky card, put it into play. If not, shuffle it into villain deck.
  • SV: Kismet deals each hero affected by a jinx card 2 psychic damage.

[hr]

Start of Villain Turn: Kismet deals each hero 1 psychic damage.

Play a Card: Scattered Mind. Put it in front of Argent Adept.

End of Villain Turn:: Reveal Karmic Distinction. Shuffle it back into the deck.

[hr]
Kismet [70]

In Play: The Talisman [7], Scattered Mind (in front of Argent Adept).

Trash:

Additional Effects:

  • SV: Kismet deals each hero 1 psychic damage.
  • Whenever a hero target deals another hero target 4 or more damage, destroy 1 jinx card.
  • EV: Reveal top of villain deck. If it is a Lucky card, put it into play. If not, shuffle it into villain deck.
  • SV: Kismet deals each hero affected by a Jinx card 2 psychic damage.
  • Increase damage dealt by Kismet by 1 (= number of Jinx cards in play)
  • Whenever Argent Adept deals damage, their player must discard 1 card.
